act.long_title: An Act to provide legal recognition for transactions carried out by means of electronic data interchange and other means of electronic communication, commonly referred to as
act.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

section.heading: Attribution of electronic records
section.html:
An electronic record shall be attributed to the originator--

(a) if it was sent by the originator himself;

(b) by a person who had the authority to act on behalf of the originator in respect of that electronic record; or

(c) by an information system programmed by or on behalf of the originator to operate automatically
